title: MCP integration layer
label: Reference architecture: how I approach this
summary: One gateway gives every assistant the same tool surface, with one adapter per service.

layers.name: MCP clients
layers.note: Assistants and workflow tools that speak the protocol.

layers.name: Gateway
layers.note: A single entry point that lists tools and routes each call.

layers.name: Adapters
layers.note: One adapter per service, so adding a service does not touch the others.

layers.name: Services
layers.note: The systems the adapters talk to, each behind its own credentials.

textAlternative: Four stages from left to right. MCP clients call a gateway. The gateway routes each call to an adapter. Each adapter talks to one service.
